name: Hyper Horusood
description: A falcon that never stoops. Hyper Horusood claims the centre and turns it into its own weather — opponents that enter the zone find their spin going somewhere it was not sent. It does not out-hit anything. It out-lasts everything.

abilities.name: Hyper Zone
abilities.description:
The zone is always on. Anything that hits Hyper Horusood lands **8% softer** and leaves **0.4 stamina** behind in the field — the attacker simply loses it.
**Horusood Field** deals no damage at all, by design: five passes through the zone, each stripping **1 stamina** and **3 stability** from the opponent. Five stamina and fifteen stability, and not one point of HP.

special_move.name: Horusood Field
special_move.description: Horusood opens the field and lets the opponent run through it five times. No damage, none intended — every pass takes 1 stamina and 3 stability instead, and the opponent leaves the zone still at full HP and no longer able to stand in it.
flavour_texts: 🌪️ **Horusood Field** — the zone opens, and the floor stops helping!
🪶 **Pass 2** — spin goes somewhere it was not sent!
🦅 **HORUSOOD FIELD** — five passes, no damage, nothing left standing!
